planned_adaptations: Visible Meteor Horizon branding and version0.1.0-native.1.
Internal solstice module/function/namespace prefixes become meteor_horizon; production Rust owned by module agent.

adaptation_notes.description: Normal schema1 identity meteor_client/version0.1.0-solstice.1 with exact b76 Horizon and cb1ad Mixins0.6; no custom loader/hooks metadata. R3 identity version bumped to0.1.0-solstice.2 to distinguish the published R2 snapshot.
Use actual mutable Game binding to apply native role/enabled/window-owner GUI blocking with closing latch.
Add transient combat reset API for owner/world lifecycle.
New attributed MIT raw Game.hud_layers compositor helper, separate from F1-sensitive ordinary HUD; distributed notice path corrected.

Normal meteor_client identity/version and b76 pin; mutable Game bindings for input/buttons; add raw cancellable HUD-layer compositor injection; retain ten support modules and23 prior injections. R3 mod version bumped to0.1.0-solstice.2; pins and24 injection declarations unchanged.
Use actual mutable Game binding to apply native role/enabled/window-owner GUI blocking with closing latch.
Replace cross-thread NoSlow switch with client-thread local switch.
Read client-thread local NoSlow switch; add one source unit test.
Brand default Spam message as Meteor Horizon; reset Reach/AutoGap transient state.
Apply native role/enabled/window-owner GUI mouse gate.
Gate native Reach by role, enabled state and current window owner.
Add native role/owner guards and reset camera/global worker state; use engine TLS switches.

Meteor Horizon identity/branding and87-entry catalog excluding reserved Auto Respawn/Fast Break; weak-window owner and observed-world lifecycle/reset; reentrant lock-free owner/GUI gates; native GUI compositor merge; five exact lifecycle/UI tests. R2 diagnostic fix: return on non-native-window Game before owner maintenance/closing-latch reset, so server pre_tick cannot clear client GUI closing input ownership. R3 packet-policy fix: refresh saved packet preferences on native re-enable and observed world rejoin, retain active/in-world gates while disabled/absent, add exact packet-preference regression test, and bump visible Runtime version to0.1.0-solstice.2.
Read client-thread local multiplier and RAII recursion guard; two source unit tests across timer helper/flags.
Use client-thread local multiplier and RAII recursion guard; source unit test support.
Apply native role/enabled/window-owner GUI wheel gate.
Add transient world-module reset API for owner/world lifecycle.
